text:
nina_cs: AxiomPay wants a short demo uplift next Fri. They rotate IPs so asked for a header allowlist + region routing (EU + APAC).
leo_support: Can you confirm qps and windows? header or IP?
nina_cs: They said ~180 sustained, 300 peak, 2026-06-18 09:00-13:00 UTC. Prefer header pin (x-axiom-demo).
ash_eng: OK. Plan: header allowlist + soft qps bump. Route to eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1. Pin model to v2-small and pre-warm KV cache 20m prior.
tori_oncall: Do 10% canary for 10m, alerts: p50>250ms or 5xx>1% -> page oncall. Autorevert after 48h unless AE requests 72h.
leo_support: Draft payload to apply:

POST /v1/overrides
{
  "customer":"axiompay",
  "regions":["eu-west-1","ap-northeast-1"],
  "allowlist":{"type":"header","name":"x-axiom-demo","value":"axiom-2026"},
  "rate_override":{"qps":300,"burst":500},
  "duration":"48h",
  "autorevert":true
}

leo_support: We'll push to staging canary then promote if healthy.
deploy-bot: change-request 3265432100: applying override to staging (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 3265432120: staging canary healthy.
leo_support: Rolling to prod 100% now; TTL allowlist 5d. Ticket CS-1592 created.
deploy-bot: change-success 3265432150: prod override applied to eu-west-1 and ap-northeast-1. Smoke checks OK.
nina_cs: Added renewal note and runbook link: https://playbooks.internal/axiompay-demo.
tori_oncall: Added rollback playbook and alert hooks.
nina_cs: Will confirm header value with AE and close after demo outcome. :thumbsup:
